regions.region: upper half: title, abstract, and introduction
regions.finding: The abstract states the overall eleven-step syntheses but does not define a separate batch experiment; cited prior whisky-lactone syntheses remain background and were not converted into current-paper experiments.
Scheme 1 depicts natural-product structures and cis/trans examples without reaction arrows or conditions; it is a structural context figure, not an experimental reaction.

Generic iodine/cyclohexane/r.t. iodolactonization of a gamma-allenoic acid is explicitly attributed to earlier work [14a]; retained as a literature_example with generic R groups rather than a newly reported batch.

unresolved: Equation (1) contains generic R1/R2 structures and no batch quantities, duration, or yield.
No Supporting Information file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.finding: Five successive arrows were extracted separately: orthoester rearrangement to the ethyl allenoate, LiAlH4 reduction to racemic 2, tosylation, NaCN displacement to 3, and nitrile hydrolysis to racemic 4. Combined two-step yields were attached only to the final product of their stated pair.

Three independent halolactonization conditions were extracted: NBS/cyclohexane (24%), NBS/CH2Cl2-THF 4:1 (42%), and I2/cyclohexane (83%, Z/E 97:3); unquantified other isomers were preserved rather than assigned yields.

The (−)-series synthetic sequence was split into its labeled stages a–i. The direct propynal-to-11 attempt was retained separately with qualitative trace yield. Detailed batches on pages 4–5 were merged into these same records rather than duplicated.

Four unsuccessful deiodination reagent systems were retained as four optimization entries with the paper's qualitative statement that the desired alkene was not obtained in an acceptable yield. The subsequent TBAF elimination and hydrogenation were linked to Scheme 5 records.

unresolved: The four failed deiodination attempts omit exact quantities, solvent, temperature, time, product distribution, and numeric yield in the main text.
The NBS rows do not state reagent quantities or workup in the covered pages.
Stereochemical SMILES are not asserted; candidate connectivity strings remain structure_verified=false.

regions.finding: Two distinct arrows were extracted: TBAF dehydroiodination of (4R,5R)-(−)-Z-6 to alkynyl lactone 13, followed by high-pressure Pd/C hydrogenation to (−)-trans-whisky lactone 14.

The natural (+)-enantiomer route was extracted by chemical stage. The combined b/c arrow was represented as desilylation to carried-forward 11 and a separate Cu-catalyzed ring opening to 12; the reported 57% remains a combined two-stage yield attached to 12.
Summary claims about eleven steps and overall strategy were not duplicated as experimental records.

Detailed racemic preparations of 2 and 3 and the beginning of hydrolysis to 4 were merged into Scheme 2 records, preserving exact masses, amounts, times, temperatures, workups, combined yields, and the cross-page continuation of item 3.

unresolved: Scheme 6 abbreviates several operations as analogous procedures; only details explicitly stated in the scheme or covered experimental paragraphs were populated.
The page-3 hydrolysis batch continues onto page 4; characterization-only continuation was not treated as a new reaction.

regions.region: upper-left continuation of racemic 4 and item 4 racemic trans-Z-6
regions.finding: Characterization of racemic 4 was linked to its page-3 hydrolysis record. The explicit I2/cyclohexane batch to racemic trans-Z-6 was merged with the Scheme 3 iodine row, including quantities, 1.5 h at room temperature, workup, 83% yield, and Z/E 97:3.

Detailed asymmetric formation of (3S,4S)-10 and TBAF desilylation to (3S,4S)-11 were merged with Scheme 4 stages c and d, preserving reagent quantities, −80/−15 °C programs, durations, workup, purification, masses, and yields.
Cu-catalyzed ring opening to 12, LiAlH4 reduction to 2, and the two-stage tosylation/NaCN sequence to 3 were merged with Scheme 4 stages e–g; item 5 characterization continues onto page 5.

unresolved: The source prints 120.5 mg and 11.3 mmol for compound 11 in the ring-opening batch; this pair is chemically inconsistent but is preserved verbatim without correction.
Several 'following the procedure' records do not independently restate all stage durations and workup volumes.

regions.finding: Characterization continuation of 3 was linked to the existing two-stage record. Hydrolysis to (Ra,R)-(−)-4 and iodolactonization to (4R,5R)-(−)-Z-6 were extracted with quantities, yields, dr/Z:E, and ee where reported.
TBAF dehydroiodination to (4R,5R)-(−)-13 and 25-atm Pd/C hydrogenation to (−)-trans-whisky lactone were linked to Scheme 5, including workup, isolated yields, masses, and ee values.

The TMS-quinine asymmetric batch to (3R,4R)-10, the carried-forward TBAF product 11, Cu-catalyzed ring opening to 12, and LiAlH4 reduction toward 2 were mapped to Scheme 6 stages a–d; item 3 continues onto page 6.

unresolved: The abbreviated (+)-series procedures omit some durations and workup details instead of restating the referenced procedure.
The (Sa,R)-(+)-2 outcome continues on page 6 and was not split into a duplicate record.

regions.finding: The alcohol 2 continuation was linked to Scheme 6 stage d. The two-stage tosylation/NaCN conversion to 3, hydrolysis to 4, and iodolactonization to (4S,5S)-(+)-Z-6 were extracted with explicit quantities and combined/stage yields, dr, Z/E, and ee.

TBAF dehydroiodination of (4S,5S)-(+)-Z-6 to (+)-13 was retained as Scheme 6 stage h with the 89% isolated yield and 98.9% ee; characterization continues across columns without creating another experiment.

High-pressure Pd/C hydrogenation to (+)-trans-whisky lactone was retained as Scheme 6 stage i with exact substrate/catalyst/solvent quantities, 25 atm H2, one day at room temperature, 90% yield, and 98.5% ee.

regions.region: middle-right Supporting Information notice and acknowledgments
regions.finding: The paper states that SI and Table S1 exist, but no SI file was supplied in this workspace; the notice was treated as availability metadata only and not as experimental evidence.

unresolved: SI Table S1 was not provided or explicitly associated, so the failed deiodination details remain missing.
All candidate SMILES remain unverified against a human-reviewed structure transcription; stereochemical labels are preserved in names rather than asserted in isomeric SMILES.
Page 7 references were used neither as experimental evidence nor claimed as covered.
